questions.solution:
No of $\mathrmO^{-2}$ per unit cell $=8 \times \frac{1}{8}+6 \times \frac{1}{2}=4$
No of $\mathrm{Al}^{+3}$ per unit cell $=4 \times \frac{1}{2}=2$
No of $\mathrm{Mn}^{+2}$ per unit cell $=8 \times \frac{1}{8}=1\mathbf{M n A l}_{2} \mathbf{O}_{4}$

questions.q: A compound is formed by two elements $M$ and $N.$ Element $N$ forms hexagonal closed pack array with $2 / 3$ of the octahedral holes occupied by $M.$& The formula of the compound is:
questions.solution:
Number of atoms of element $' N '$ per unit cell$= 6$
Number of atoms of element $M$ per unit cell
$= \dfrac{2}{3}$ (Number of octahedral voids per unit cell)
$= \dfrac{2}{3} \times 6 = 4$
$M: N = 4: 6 = 2: 3$
Formula is ${M}_{2}{N}_{3}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
A two dimensional solid is made by alternating circles with radius $a$ and $b$ such that the sides of the circles touch. The packing fraction is defined as the ratio of the area under the circles to the area under the rectangle with sides of length $x$ and $y.$

The ratio $r = b / a$ for which the packing fraction is minimized is closest to:
questions.solution:
Area of rectangle$= xy$

$= 2a ( 2a + 2b )$

$= 4a ( a + b )$

Area covered by circles$= {\pi a}^{2} + {\pi b}^{2} = \pi\left({a}^{2} + {b}^{2}\right)$

Packing fraction (P.F.)$= \dfrac{\pi\left({a}^{2} + {b}^{2}\right)}{4\left({a}^{2} + ab\right)}$

$= \dfrac{{\pi a}^{2}\left(1 + \dfrac{{b}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}\right)}{4{a}^{2}\left(1 + \dfrac{b}{a}\right)}$

Putting $r = \left(\dfrac{b}{a}\right)$

$P . F . = \dfrac{\pi\left(1 + {r}^{2}\right)}{4 ( 1 + r )}$

For minimum P.F., $\dfrac{d ( P . F . )}{dr} = 0$

or $\dfrac{\pi}{4}\left[\dfrac{2r ( 1 + r ) - \left(1 + {r}^{2}\right)}{( 1 + r{)}^{2}}\right] = 0$

$⇒ {r}^{2} + 2r - 1 = 0$

or $r = \dfrac{- 2 + \sqrt{4 + 4}}{2} = \sqrt{2} - 1 = 0 . 414$

Answer is option (A)
